meta.h1: The Candidate Experience Audit: 50-Point Checklist for World-Class Recruiting

markdown:
## Why Candidate Experience Is a Business Priority

Virgin Media famously calculated that poor candidate experience cost them $5 million annually in lost subscriptions. Candidates who have negative experiences:

- Tell 9-15 people about it
- Leave negative Glassdoor reviews
- Never apply again
- May stop using your product or service

### The 50-Point Audit Checklist

#### Job Discovery (Points 1-10)

- ☐ Career page loads in under 3 seconds
- ☐ Jobs are searchable by location, function, and level
- ☐ Each posting includes salary range
- ☐ Company culture is showcased with authentic content
- ☐ Benefits are listed clearly
- ☐ Application process timeline is visible
- ☐ Mobile-optimized experience
- ☐ Job descriptions use inclusive language
- ☐ Clear value proposition for candidates
- ☐ Easy-to-find "Apply" button

#### Application Process (Points 11-20)

- ☐ Application takes under 5 minutes
- ☐ Resume parsing works accurately
- ☐ No duplicate data entry required
- ☐ LinkedIn/Indeed quick-apply enabled
- ☐ Progress indicator shows completion status
- ☐ Save and resume functionality
- ☐ No account creation required to apply
- ☐ Confirmation email sent immediately
- ☐ Expected timeline communicated
- ☐ Accessibility standards met (WCAG 2.1)

#### Screening Phase (Points 21-30)

- ☐ Response within 48 hours of application
- ☐ Personalized rejection emails (not generic)
- ☐ Phone screen scheduled within 1 week
- ☐ Interviewer is prepared (reviewed resume)
- ☐ Candidate receives agenda before screen
- ☐ Two-way conversation (not interrogation)
- ☐ Next steps communicated clearly
- ☐ Timeline commitment honored
- ☐ Candidate can ask questions
- ☐ Feedback provided to unsuccessful candidates

#### Interview Stage (Points 31-40)

- ☐ Self-service scheduling available
- ☐ Interview preparation guide sent in advance
- ☐ Interviewers introduce themselves and their role
- ☐ Questions are relevant and non-discriminatory
- ☐ Candidate meets future teammates
- ☐ Office tour or virtual workspace demo
- ☐ Reasonable number of rounds (max 3-4)
- ☐ Travel reimbursement offered if applicable
- ☐ Accommodations offered proactively
- ☐ Decision communicated within 48 hours

#### Offer and Close (Points 41-50)

- ☐ Verbal offer preceded by written
- ☐ Offer details are comprehensive and clear
- ☐ Reasonable decision timeline (3-5 business days)
- ☐ Negotiation handled professionally
- ☐ Rejection calls for finalists (not email)
- ☐ Pre-boarding communication begins immediately
- ☐ Welcome materials sent before Day 1
- ☐ First-day logistics clearly communicated
- ☐ Candidate experience survey sent
- ☐ Feedback loop to improve process

### Scoring Your Audit

- 40-50 points : World-class experience
- 30-39 points : Good with room for improvement
- 20-29 points : Significant gaps affecting quality of hire
- Below 20 : Urgent need for redesign

### Quick Wins

If you score below 30, start with these high-impact fixes:

- Simplify application to under 5 minutes
- Send acknowledgment within 1 hour
- Respond to all candidates within 48 hours
- Provide feedback to interviewed candidates

Our pre-scored candidate delivery ensures candidates experience a professional, transparent process from first contact.
